bias.en: Downtrend · 9.5% rebound, back above the April low
bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 反弹 9.5%，重回 4 月低点上方

read.en: Marvell rose 9.5% on Nov 9 to $154.60, trading $142.28–157.68. It is above the falling 5-day average ($152.22) but below the falling 10-day ($184.25), 30-day ($232.01) and 100-day ($230.81) and the rising 200-day ($185.42). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 29 ($209.06), and RSI is 32.
read.zh: Marvell 11月9日上涨 9.5%，收于 $154.60，盘中区间 $142.28–157.68。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$152.22）上方，但仍在下行的 10 日（$184.25）、30 日（$232.01）和 100 日均线（$230.81）以及上行的 200 日均线（$185.42）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月29日起看空（$209.06），RSI 为 32。

read.en: The rebound reclaimed the $146.3–146.9 zone (Apr 28 low, Nov 6 high), now support, but the close sat just below the $154.78 Nov 4 low. Resistance is $154.8–158 (Nov 4 and May 12 lows), then $162.9 (Jul 29 low) and $171.4–172 (Nov 2–3 closes). Support is $152.2 (5-day), then $146.3–146.9 and $135.3. A close above $158 would target $163–172; below $146.3, $135–142.

r.en: Nov 4 low $154.78; Nov 9 high $157.68; May 12 low $157.96
